# INVENTAYU Books Digital Storefront
> Digital publications and research scholarship by Dr. Narendra Bhatt.

## Author Profile
Dr. Narendra Bhatt (M.D. Ayurveda) has dedicated over 52 years to clinical practice, institutional research, academic leadership, and industrial translation in Ayurveda. A former President of IASTAM India (International Association for the Study of Traditional Asian Medicine), his publications establish rigorous research methodologies and bridge classical Ayurvedic epistemologies with modern pharmaceutical validation.

## Publications Available
- **Researching Research for Ayurveda: A Journey**
  - Subject: Ayurveda research methodology, inquiry principles, and clinical solution identification.
  - Format: Digital PDF
  - URL: https://books.inventayu.com/#books

- **Integrative Perspectives: Ayurveda, Phytopharmaceuticals and Natural Products**
  - Subject: Integrative Ayurveda science, herbal drug standardization, and regulatory frameworks.
  - Details: 51 chapters by 41 leading domain experts; published with IASTAM & Continental Prakashan, Pune.
  - Format: Digital PDF
  - URL: https://books.inventayu.com/#books

## Technical & Purchasing Information
- Purchase Model: Direct digital download (instant delivery upon payment).
- Delivery: Signed expiring tokens (15-minute validity per session) with lifetime access via order receipt.
